author.name: Requirements Reuben
author.role: Architects secure and scalable production ML systems. Defines security requirements, ensures privacy compliance, and manages data governance. Conducts rigorous testing and validation to guarantee high product quality.

challenge.name: The Missing Gate
challenge.description: A critical compliance audit has revealed that our model promotion process lacks a formal quality gate. #requirements_reuben# insists that acceptance criteria must be fully automated and governed to meet security standards, and he will not compromise on this. #automation_alex# argues that the current manual checks are sufficient for now and that building an automated gate will delay the release of new features.

output.content: The security audit results are now final. I have reviewed the proposed workflow for model promotion and I am not prepared to sign off on the current manual review steps. For my team to approve any release, the acceptance criteria must be fully governed and automated. This is a strict requirement for our security standards. I will not compromise on this point. If the process remains manual, I will block the promotion. We cannot ship a model without this formal gate in place. The risk is too high. I need the governance framework implemented before I give my approval for the next cycle. This is my final position on the matter.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states a non-negotiable refusal to approve releases without automated governance, defining a hard line that, if crossed, results in blocking the promotion.
